{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — loc scope (test/example)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)
    *)
      echo "⚠️  crap4dart $C4D_VER is too old for the gates (need >= 0.11.0);" \
           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — loc scope (test/example)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)
    *)
      echo "⚠️  crap4dart $C4D_VER is too old for the gates (need >= 0.11.0);" \
           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block

    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via

      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was

      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a

      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2

restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."

      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are

      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `inner.split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` then carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is now reversible — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` are escaped before separators flatten, so a hyphen round-trips exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme, keeping existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stable. `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes and keeps the legacy split for escape-free (legacy) slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by the mailbox `.id`) and only falls back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`, shared with `_registrySlugFor`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake`, which verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart`: hyphenated-path round-trip, reversible-slug shape, percent/colon round-trip, legacy-slug compat, hyphenated session-folder layout — all RED before the fix, PASSED after.
- `test/messaging/file_messaging_repository_test.dart`: registry stores the exact hyphenated cwd; `directory()` prefers the registry cwd over the lossy decode and falls back when the registry has no cwd.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart`: `launchMailboxWake` refuses a missing cwd and a file-at-cwd without touching the shell; spawns in an existing cwd.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — 4530 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (env-gated skips, pre-existing).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects (created before the fix) remain genuinely ambiguous — a slug like `--w-postal-nl--` decodes as before; the registry-preferred cwd is what repairs the wake path for them. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- A folder name containing a literal `%2D`/`%25`-like sequence could in principle be mis-read as an escape; accepted as an astronomically rare trade-off (documented in the code).
- No breaking changes for existing sessions: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs, and session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`_encodeCwd` flattens `/`, `\`, `:` into `-` and `decodeSessionCwd` reverses that with `split('-').join('/')` — a many-to-one mapping. A literal `-` in a directory name is indistinguishable from an encoded separator, so any hyphenated workspace (e.g. `/Users/Yury_Bakhmutski/_w/postal-nl`) decodes to a path that does not exist (`.../postal/nl`). `MailboxEntry.cwd` and `messages-registry.json` carry the bogus path, and the mailbox-wake spawn dies with `ProcessException: No such file or directory` — an asleep mailbox can never be woken.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: slug encoding is reversible now — `%`→`%25`, literal `-`→`%2D`, `:`→`%3A` escape before separators flatten, so hyphens round-trip exactly. Paths without those characters encode byte-identically to the legacy scheme (existing on-disk slug folders and pi's layout stay stable). `decodeSessionCwd` unescapes per segment when a slug carries escapes, keeping the legacy split for legacy slugs.
- `lib/src/messaging/file_messaging_repository.dart`: `_recordRegistry` stores the live env's exact cwd instead of a lossy slug round-trip; `directory()` prefers the registry's exact cwd (keyed by mailbox `.id`), falling back to slug decode. Registry read extracted into `_readRegistry()`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_inbox.dart`: wake spawning extracted into public `launchMailboxWake` — verifies the cwd exists (and is not a plain file) before spawning and returns a named refusal instead of a raw process exception; `AgentCli._launchMailboxWake` delegates to it.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (RED before, PASSED after): hyphenated-cwd slug round-trip + reversible-slug layout (`session_repo_test.dart`); exact-cwd registry write + registry-preferred `directory()` (`file_messaging_repository_test.dart`); wake refusal for missing/file cwd without spawning (`agent_cli_test.dart`).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **4530 passed, 0 failed**, 6 skipped (pre-existing env-gated).

### Notes

- Legacy on-disk slugs of hyphenated projects stay ambiguous (unchanged decode); the registry-preferred cwd repairs their wake path. New sessions write reversible slugs.
- No breaking changes: hyphen-free cwds produce byte-identical slugs; session listing reads cwd from file headers, not slugs.

blocks.text:
restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
